prompt:
You are a credit rating analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2026-04-23, assign the issuer a letter credit rating on the 21-grade scale below (finest granularity you can justify).
Valid answers (choose exactly one): AAA, AA+, AA, AA-, A+, A, A-, BBB+, BBB, BBB-, BB+, BB, BB-, B+, B, B-, CCC+, CCC, CCC-, CC, C.
Company information (as of 2026-04-23):
Fiscal period 2026 Q1 (filed 2026-04-23). Revenue 20,880M, gross margin 85%, operating income 6,598M (operating margin 32%), net income 2,971M, diluted EPS 4.28. Total assets 308,894M, total liabilities 274,899M, shareholders' equity 33,995M. Current assets 56,524M vs current liabilities 159,640M (current ratio 0.35), retained earnings 26,088M.
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
Strong profitability (32% op margin) and scale provide some support, but leverage is extreme (equity is only ~11% of assets) and the 0.35 current ratio signals acute liquidity/funding risk that outweighs earnings quality.
DECISION: BB
